stories.title: ‘Welsh can tell any story’: Cymraeg dub of Star Wars premieres in Cardiff
stories.summary: Actors Mark Lewis Jones and Osian Morgan, who voiced characters in dub of 1977 film, among guests on red carpet It has been a memorable few days for Wales. At the weekend, the men’s rugby team secured a historic win against New Zealand – their first victory over the All Blacks in more than 70 years. Then on Thursday evening came another culturally significant moment when Cardiff rolled out the red carpet to celebrate the first Welsh-language dub of the Star Wars franchise. Stars of stage and screen who voiced the words of Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, C-3PO et al in Welsh (Cymraeg) over the original 1977 Star Wars film took the plaudits at the Cineworld Cardiff screening.
